prompt_text: 请分析这段拉伸试验视频，判断是否存在断裂。视频将被处理为最多 8 帧，请判断断裂发生在哪两帧之间。按 JSON 格式输出：has_fracture、fracture_between、type、location、confidence。

notes: No automatic JSON/schema extraction is performed. Judge prompt quality from raw_output in evaluation_records.jsonl.
Ground-truth metadata is included only as reference context for manual inspection.
